about: The Law Office of Brandon R. Bytnar works from Galleria Court in North Naples across estate planning, probate and real estate, and its Google listing averages a flat five stars across 147 reviews, the largest count in this ranking.

On the seven pages we read it publishes nothing about what a closing costs, nothing about where client funds are held, and none of the stages of a transaction, which is what pillar B measures in this practice. It names no attorney on the pages we could reach either.
